entries.title: Boca Chica / Starship Flight 15
entries.dates: November 8, 2026 – launch week. Flight 15 officially Friday, November 13, 2026 — 75-minute window opens 4:45 PM CT / 5:45 PM EST.
entries.location: Boca Chica, Texas — Starship Flight 15 launch
entries.stayed: Isla Blanca Park, South Padre Island — for the launch itself, as few days as possible due to cost
entries.notes:
Plan: Take Witherwings to Boca Chica for Starship Flight 15. Stay at Isla Blanca Park on South Padre Island for the launch.
Before the trip: RV oil change to be done at least 3 days before the actual launch date. DONE Oct 17, 2026 at 23,704 miles.
On the road: Dump black and gray tanks and fill water every 3rd or 4th day. Look for Twice The Ice locations spaced 3–4 days apart — we do not drink the RV water.
Departure: Left Columbus, Indiana at 11:00 AM on Sunday, November 8, 2026. Odometer at departure: 23,707 miles. First leg: south to stage at Yolanda's in Texas.
entries.highlights:
Anticipated lunch was first listed as November 6th then November 12th and November 13th.
Stopped between Nashville and Memphis for late lunch
Saw a bobcat run right across the campsite at Adolph Thomae Jr. County Park (Arroyo City) — Thursday, November 12, 2026
Spent the night at the South Padre Island Visitor Center — Thursday, November 12, 2026 (launch eve, waiting for the 6:00 AM Isla Blanca park opening); got in line at the park at 4:30 AM with 10 cars ahead of us. Good entry timing.  Still several decent spots available after we parked.
